decks.notes: This deck is focused on using enchantments to draw cards and generate mana, creating powerful synergy and combos. It heavily relies on the presence of Argothian Enchantress and Enchantress's Presence, along with other enchantments like Elephant Grass and Sterling Grove to fuel its engine. The deck also includes some combo pieces like Opalescence and Parallax Wave to control the board. In addition, it utilizes cards like Living Wish and Exploration to further its strategy. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with enchantments and out-value them through card advantage and mana generation.

This deck focuses on using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore while controlling the board with disruptive spells like Sphere of Resistance, Pyroclasm, and Winter's Grasp. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with disruptive cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port while utilizing mana acceleration from cards like Mox Diamond. The mana base is designed to support both the green and red spells in the deck, allowing for consistent casting of threats and disruption. Overall, the strategy revolves around controlling the game through powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

The main theme of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells in order to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Using cheap, efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and often. The inclusion of cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Barbarian Ring also ensures that the opponent has limited time to find answers before succumbing to the relentless assault of this aggressive red deck.

The main focus of this deck is to use Survival of the Fittest to search for key creatures that can control the game by disrupting opponent's strategies and generating value each turn. With the help of key creatures like Spike Feeder, Quirion Ranger, and Tradewind Rider, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent while utilizing Winter Orb to slow down their resources. The mana acceleration provided by cards like Birds of Paradise and Gaea's Cradle helps to power out powerful plays and maintain control over the game.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature play with Nimble Mongoose and Skittering Skirge, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with countermagic and hand disruption spells like Duress. The inclusion of powerful removal spells like Vindicate and Lightning Bolt helps control the board, and efficient card draw with Sylvan Library allows for consistency. The mana base is designed to support a variety of colors for maximum flexibility in casting spells. Armageddon serves as a potential blowout card to further disrupt the opponent's resources.

The main concept of this deck is to combine various creatures with abilities that allow for manipulation of life totals and card selection. By using cards like Survival of the Fittest and Living Wish, the player can search for their combo pieces such as Daru Spiritualist and Shaman en-Kor to gain massive amounts of life while setting up their win condition. The deck aims to create an infinite loop where the player gains an unlimited amount of life, ultimately leading to a victory through attrition or alternate win conditions.

This deck focuses on maintaining control over the game through various spells and artifacts. The strategy involves board wipes like Wrath of God and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to keep the opponent's board in check. Cards like Humility and Seal of Cleansing provide additional control over the battlefield. The deck also includes ways to generate card advantage and mana ramp with cards like Temporal Aperture and Thran Dynamo. Overall, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent with a combination of control elements and resilient threats like Eternal Dragon.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Oath of Druids card to quickly get powerful creatures like Terravore and Exalted Angel into play, while controlling the game with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Cataclysm. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Sphere of Resistance to slow down opponents, along with utility cards like Sylvan Library and Seal of Cleansing. The mana base consists of land destruction with Rishadan Port and Wasteland, as well as creature lands like Treetop Village for an additional threat. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures.

This deck revolves around utilizing enchantresses to draw cards and quickly ramping up mana through enchantments like Wild Growth and Fertile Ground. The goal is to eventually cast powerful spells like Replenish or use Living Wish to search for key pieces to execute a game-winning combo. With a mixture of control elements like Seal of Removal and trade-offs like Words of Wind, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of card advantage and mana acceleration to secure victory.

The aim of this deck is to quickly assemble and protect the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle. By using cards like Foil, Force of Will, and Daze to protect the combo piece, as well as disruption spells like Duress and Counterspell to control the game, this deck aims to create an unbeatable threat in a short amount of time. With card draw and selection in the form of Impulse and Vision Charm, the deck is designed to efficiently find and utilize its key cards for a powerful win condition.

The deck focuses on quickly getting creatures onto the battlefield and utilizing the Madness mechanic to cast spells at a reduced cost. With cards like Basking Rootwalla, Wild Mongrel, and Squee, Goblin Nabob, the deck is able to maintain a high level of aggression. By combining blue counter spells with the card advantage from Careful Study and Survival of the Fittest, the deck is able to control the game while still pressuring the opponent's life total. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive cards like Daze and Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with small, efficient white creatures like Savannah Lions, Silver Knight, and Mother of Runes, supported by cards like Swords to Plowshares for removal and Glorious Anthem for a power boost. The inclusion of cards like Worship and True Believer provide protection against opponents' strategies, while utility cards like Enlightened Tutor and Seal of Cleansing offer additional flexibility. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced, aggressive strategy while disrupting their game plan with targeted removal and disruptive spells.
